test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Simplify the following expression: 

 (sin theta)/(1+cos theta)+(1+cos theta)/(sin theta)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Put **θ = 90°** in the given expression.

⇒ [sin 90° / (1 + cos 90°)] + [(1 + cos 90°) / sin 90°]

⇒ [1 / (1 + 0)] + [(1 + 0) / 1] = 1 + 1 = **2**.

Check options for θ = 90°: (2) 2 cosec 90° = 2 × 1 = **2**.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 cosec θ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** [sin θ / (1 + cos θ)] + [(1 + cos θ) / sin θ]

**Formula Used:** sin²θ + cos²θ = 1; cosec θ = 1 / sin θ

⇒ Take **LCM** of denominators: sin θ (1 + cos θ)

⇒ [sin²θ + (1 + cos θ)²] / [sin θ (1 + cos θ)]

⇒ [sin²θ + 1 + cos²θ + 2 cos θ] / [sin θ (1 + cos θ)]

⇒ [(sin²θ + cos²θ) + 1 + 2 cos θ] / [sin θ (1 + cos θ)]

⇒ [1 + 1 + 2 cos θ] / [sin θ (1 + cos θ)]

⇒ [2 + 2 cos θ] / [sin θ (1 + cos θ)]

⇒ 2(1 + cos θ) / [sin θ (1 + cos θ)]

⇒ 2 / sin θ = **2 cosec θ**

**∴ The correct answer is 2 cosec θ.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

Fundamental identities include **sin²θ + cos²θ = 1**, **1 + tan²θ = sec²θ**, and **1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ**.

Reciprocal Relations

The function **cosec θ** is the reciprocal of **sin θ**, and **sec θ** is the reciprocal of **cos θ**.</p
